briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with frontier labs releasing iterative models weekly. Compute constraints and safety gaps remain primary bottlenecks amid record funding.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced reasoning chains while Anthropic's Claude 4 and xAI's Grok 3.5 push context windows past 2M tokens. DeepSeek-V4 closed the gap on coding benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New red-teaming reports highlight multi-agent attack surfaces.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp and TSMC 2nm allocations dominate Q2 spend. Microsoft and Google announced new 100k H100-equivalent clusters in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory capture or open-source proliferation determine the 2027 AGI inflection point?
